// One-bit sequential circuit with combinational logic
module TopModule(
    input  clk,
    input  a,
    input  b,
    output reg q,
    output reg state
);
    reg [1:0] state_comb;
    always @(*) begin
        state_comb = {a, b};
        case ({q, state_comb})
            2'b00: begin q=1; state=1; end
            2'b01: begin q=1; state=1; end
            2'b10: begin q=0; state=0; end
            2'b11: begin q=0; state=0; end
        endcase
    end
endmodule
